{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment turns positive (≥0.67), pull forward and amplify near-term forecasts to close gap with quickly rising prices",
    "Sentiment stagnation (all values ≤0.33) indicates model lag—flatten mid-range forecasts to avoid systematic undershoot",
    "Detecting mean-reversion bias when prices anchor near 76.50, compress forecast amplitude by 30-40% to match price range constraints",
    "Positive sentiment spike (1.00) requires immediate forecast steepening; 2+ consecutive high sentiment days demand sustained above-trend output",
    "Model forecasts exceed 80 when sentiment is weak—apply downward correction of 0.5-1.0 for 5-10 day horizon to prevent overshoot",
    "When true outcomes consistently lag forecasts by 0.2-0.4, shift mid-period trajectory downward by matching lag magnitude",
    "Sentiment reversal (0.00 → 0.67) within 3 days calls for V-shaped forecast adjustment; ignore older sentiment signals in favor of latest"
] }
